cells.forex: Leverage, gaps around news and weekends, widening spreads, and broker-related risks.
cells.stocks: Company-specific falls, gaps on news, and the share losing most of its value.
cells.penny_stocks: Thin trading, wide spreads, dilution, promotions and manipulation, halts, and being unable to sell.
cells.commodities: Leverage, supply shocks, roll costs and sudden gaps.
cells.futures: Leverage, [[gap|gaps]], margin calls and forced liquidation; losses can exceed the margin.

caveat: Risks differ by product, broker and jurisdiction as well as by market. Every market can lose money, and past calm is not a guarantee.
